name: rocket_status
summary: Every rocket, or one, read from the game: where it is and where it goes, mass, fuel lines, engines, thrust, landing confidence, cargo, power, burn time. compact and parts shape it. Read only.

help.text: explanations (what the thrust and landing numbers mean) come once per reply. compact leaves out mass parts, fuel tanks, power devices and checks. parts lists every part with its pose, enough to build the rocket again.
help.keys: rockets [{reference_id, network_id, name, automated_landing, auto_shut_off, manned, re_entry_profile, re_entry_altitude_m, ...}], count, explanations.

where.text: where: state (OnLaunchMount, Launching, InSpace, Landing), mode, current and target node (name, map code, code_value: the number the avionics' DestinationCode takes, charted), progress, altitude above the launch mount while launching or landing, velocity, acceleration, flight rule, and the route left as the game will fly it: re-planned at each node, fewest hops, through uncharted nodes too; a hop's distance is twice the map distance and is also its delta-v. manned: someone sits in a Crew Module Chair (only launch mounts can be targeted).

mass_fuel.text: mass: total, structure (1 kg per filled cargo slot included), gas (in the rocket's pipes, tanks and engine chambers), payload_kg, parts by kind. fuel: each engine input network (input 1 and 2 of every engine; a Pressure Fed Liquid Engine's input 2 is a heat exchanger) with pipe litres and mol, total mol, liquid mol and litres, pipe gas kPa (what pressure-fed engines read), feeds (which engine inputs draw from it), mix fractions, temperature, and its tanks (litres, mol, K, kPa, whether the game counts them for mass). pipe_networks: every pipe network on the rocket in short, engine lines and the rest such as a tanker's cargo or socket line: network_id, volume_l, total_mol, pressure_kpa, temperature_k, gases_mol, feeds (empty when no engine draws from it).

engines.text: engines: name, feed (its feed law with the game's numbers), input networks, missing_input, on, powered, throttle, thrust, mol drawn last tick, exhaust, prefab max thrust, watts, modelled. thrust: current, max_recorded, prefab_max, max_expected (what the landing check uses), achievable_full (every engine's first full-throttle tick on the lines as they are, by the game's combustion on a copy), recorded_exceeds_achievable. burn_time: the game's estimate, and ours at full and current throttle.

landing.text: landing_check: the confidence the Rocket Control screen shows (the ground pad's hop, world gravity). landing_at_pad: the check the game makes at re-entry toward the target pad, else its home pad: {pad, orbital (an Orbital Launch Mount uses gravity 1 m/s2), delta_v, confidence, band, min required thrust}.

other.text: collects: what the gear can bring home or do (ore, ice, gas, chart, discover, survey, surface_scan; rocket_mining_options has the detail). cargo: holds with filled, slots and kg. power: charge, capacity, percent, load per 0.5 s tick, seconds left, every device's watts and whether auto shut-off leaves it on. checks (self_test): the forecast's formulas against the game's numbers. parts: each hull piece and internal part with prefab, label, role, offset in metres from the engine mount in its frame, rotation as place_structure takes it, and slot contents.

rocket_id.description: A rocket, its rocket network, or any part; left out, every rocket.

self_test.description: Compare the forecast's formulas with the game's numbers. Default true (false with compact).

compact.description: Short form: no mass parts, fuel tanks, power devices or checks. Default false.

parts.description: Every part with its pose relative to the engine mount and its slot contents. Default false.
